subject: [PATCH 2/8] selftests/mm: check that MADV_PAGEOUT skips holes and swapped pages

2026-10-14.patch_summary: This patch adds two new test cases to the madvise selftest suite in Linux. The tests, 'pageout_skips_pte_hole' and 'pageout_skips_swapped_pte', verify that the MADV_PAGEOUT operation skips over holes in page tables and swapped-out pages, similar to how MADV_COLD operates. This ensures that MADV_PAGEOUT adheres to its contract and does not attempt to populate or fault-in such regions.
